name: Claude PDF Analysis Bundle 📜
description_md:
What You Get 🚀
Here’s what’s included:
PDFs Used in Demos
Access to the same PDFs used in the video demonstrations.
Google Drive Integration
Step-by-step guide to uploading, sharing, and analyzing PDFs from Google Drive.
Claude Analysis Replit
A deployable Replit project for running Claude-powered PDF analysis.
Replit Link
Direct access to the Replit workspace used in the demo.
Google Colab Integration
Run AI-driven PDF analysis in a cloud-based environment with minimal setup.
Claude PDF Analysis
Custom workflows to extract insights from PDFs using Claude AI.
Custom GPT Schema & Prompt
Structured templates for integrating PDF analysis into your own custom GPTs.
Bonus: Sample Postman Request
Easily test and interact with the Claude PDF analysis API.
If this is useful to you, I’d love your support for the channel ❤️‍🔥
